title: I Wish I Would Have Loved This One, But I Didn't – A Multilingual Dataset for Counterfactual Detection in Product Reviews

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance by training counterfactual detection models with and without masking the specific clue phrases (e.g., "wish", "should have") that were used during the data collection process, in order to test if the models are overfitting to these lexical artifacts.
